LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.0.label: Trinity Confluence
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.0.descripti: Retains original damage, critical value, cleave, chain, work speed and movement speed. Grants no abilities. Later skill-hit effects require actual damage from a RimHex ability; ordinary attacks and original cleave or chain do not qualify.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.1.label: Spell to Steel
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.1.descripti: A damaging RimHex ability hit marks its victim for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds, with one mark maximum. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.2.label: Steel to Spell
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.2.descripti: An actual ordinary critical hit marks its victim for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds, with one mark maximum. A later damaging RimHex ability hit on that enemy consumes it for 75 bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.3.label: Spellblade Respite
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.3.descripti: After Spell to Steel deals actual bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.4.label: Spellblade Guard
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.4.descripti: After Spell to Steel deals actual bonus damage, shield yourself for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.5.label: Prismatic Refraction
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.5.descripti: After Steel to Spell deals actual bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.6.label: Prismatic Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Trinity.nodes.6.descripti: After Steel to Spell deals actual bonus damage, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Never shields you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.
